description: registry_tx_equity_candidates for many subjects in one call (1–50, e.g. a consultant's client parcels): each subject's id (your label, echoed back) and its urn, or county_fips and apn, plus the rule parameters once for every subject (area_band, year_band, min_matches, limit, tax_year, same_building_class, same_local_use_code, local_use_codes). Each entry of results is that subject's answer from registry_tx_equity_candidates (subject, candidates, calc_args, selection, selection_rule, sources, warnings) or that subject's error (error, message, issues, and coverage on a miss), so one subject outside Texas, in Tarrant County, or not in the registry does not fail the others; the Texas-only and Tarrant checks apply to each subject. The selection rule and the notice appear once at the top (rule, notice) instead of in every answer; summary counts subjects, answered and errors. Candidates per subject only: this tool never runs calc_tx_unequal_appraisal and never picks comparables; a person decides, for each subject, which candidates (if any) to use, and only those go to calc_tx_unequal_appraisal (each subject's calc_args is its candidate list in that tool's input shape, for review and editing first). Relay each candidate's source rights from that subject's sources. For evidence calculations only: FactLot does not represent property owners, file protests, or advise whether to protest. Not an appraisal or an opinion of value (Tex. Occ. Code §1103.003(1)); not legal or tax advice and not a substitute for the advice of an attorney. Never returns owner names, mailing addresses, or ownership facts: ownership is outside this comparison. On the hosted API each answered subject counts as one registry lookup, and subjects with an error are given back (a subject not in the registry inside loaded coverage as an answer that finds nothing, not counted up to an hourly limit and counted past it); this batch tool needs a Pro or Team key; registry_tx_equity_candidates, one subject per call, stays within the free daily lookups. Requires a FactLot Registry (public-record facts about commercial property, each cited to the source file and record).

area_band.description: Improvement area band as a share of the subject's (0.35: within ±35%). Must be greater than 0.

limit.description: Maximum candidates returned (1–200; a larger value is refused). Fewer are returned when fewer meet the rule, or when the neighborhood and ZIP code tiers hold at least min_matches, because the rest of the county is then not included; a warning gives the counts.

local_use_codes.description: Only parcels whose local use code is one of these, compared exactly as the roll prints them (1–50 codes). Default: no use-code test.

min_matches.description: Widen from the neighborhood and ZIP code tiers to the whole county when they hold fewer than this.

same_building_class.description: Only parcels whose building class (from the compared roll year) is exactly the subject's. Not applied, with a warning, when the subject has none. Default false: building class is not compared.

same_local_use_code.description: Only parcels whose local use code (the district's own use or class code) is exactly the subject's. Not applied, with a warning, when the subject has none or local_use_codes is given. Default false.

subjects.description: The subject parcels (1–50): each one's id and its urn, or county_fips and apn (with state_fips 48, or none).

apn.description: Appraisal district account number as the district prints it.

county_fips.description: 3-digit Texas county FIPS, e.g. "201" for Harris County.

id.description: Your label for this subject (a client or account), echoed back with its answer. Unique within the batch.

state_fips.description: With county_fips and apn: "48" (Texas), the only state served.

urn.description: FactLot parcel URN of the subject, e.g. fl:parcel:us-48201:0011440000001. Give this, or county_fips and apn.

tax_year.description: Roll year to compare in: the subject and every candidate are read from that year's roll files only (building class also from that year's buildings file, named in selection.building_class_sources); selection.compared_files lists the files the compared values are cited from. Default: the newest tax year whose roll gives the subject a positive value. A year whose files hold values but no category code or improvement area gives no candidates, with a warning naming the missing facts. On the hosted API, tax_year needs a Pro or Team key.

year_band.description: Year-built band in years, applied when both the subject's and the candidate's are known.

title: Texas unequal-appraisal candidates (batch)
